articles.title: Éric Cantona: ‘If I regret something about the kung fu kick, it’s that I would love to kick him in another…
articles.dek: Before the release of a new documentary, the unrepentant Manchester United icon reflects on his deep bond with English football and his darker instincts “I’m an angel and…
articles.description: Before the release of a new documentary, the unrepentant Manchester United icon reflects on his deep bond with English football and his darker instincts “I’m an angel and a demon,” Éric Cantona says intently during a gripping new documentary about his life on and off the football pitch. “And an angel or a demon, you love him or you hate him. I’m far from being the person with the greatest integrity. I’m far from being the person who always tells the truth. I’m far from being the person who has never been hypocritical. Maybe I’m a good person, but I can also be a flower of evil. It’s the first time in my life I’ve realised this. I am a flower of evil, and I find it very beautiful.” It’s hard to know what to expect from the only written interview pinned to the release of Cantona: Flower of Evil . Joel Cantona has warned that his famous brother will walk out at any mention of the enduring crisis surrounding Manchester United , whether it’s a question about Mauricio Pochettino’s arrival or the Glazer family’s ruinous ownership of the club. Continue reading...

articles.description: Democrats to examine Fifa Forward Enterprise scandal Infantino could be subpoenaed to give evidence in January A number of past and present Fifa employees have received letters requesting they attend interviews for a Congressional investigation into the global governing body sparked by the Fifa Forward Enterprise scandal. articles.description: The French side earned their first group win over troubled German giants as Bellingham and Betis also caught the eye Bayern Munich have hit a snagging point, with injuries wracking Vincent Kompany’s squad just as the head coach returns to work following his own health scare. For Lille’s winner, to exact Bayern’s first loss of the season, Aleksandar Pavlović had an own goal for the ages, desperately chasing back to then somehow direct the ball into his own net. Bayern are 15th in the Champions League table, and with Harry Kane out until well into 2027 and 18-year-old Lennart Karl asked to lead the line, resources are stretched. Jamal Musiala, subject of club grandees Uli Hoeness and Karl Heinz-Rummenigge’s gripes over his contract in the light of his neurological condition, could also play only 15 minutes. articles.title: ‘Not Bayern-like’: Joshua Kimmich fumes at club’s treatment of Jamal Musiala

articles.description: Bundesliga champions lost 2-1 to Lille on Wednesday Kimmich defends Musiala’s neurological condition The Bayern Munich midfielder Joshua Kimmich has launched a stinging attack on the club’s “not Bayern-like” treatment of his teammate Jamal Musiala, who has a condition which causes seizures. Senior Bayern figures have publicly questioned Musiala’s performances and contract after repeated seizures caused by a neurological condition, including two on the field in pre-season games, drawing protests from the players’ union Fifpro. Now Kimmich, the club’s vice captain, has spoken out and warned Bayern risked undermining their family image. Continue reading...

Bundesliga champions lost 2-1 to Lille on Wednesday Kimmich defends Musiala’s neurological condition The Bayern Munich midfielder Joshua Kimmich has launched a stinging attack on the club’s “not Bayern-like” treatment of his teammate Jamal Musiala, who has a condition which causes seizures. Senior Bayern figures have publicly questioned Musiala’s performances and contract after repeated seizures caused by a neurological condition, including two on the field in pre-season games, drawing protests from the players’ union Fifpro. Now Kimmich, the club’s vice captain, has spoken out and warned Bayern risked undermining their family image.
